== Summary ==
''•Skywalker Ranch'', a special promotional Location card [[Decipher]] made to show Lucasfilm; not a playtest card (Bill Bisco, personal communication, 21 October 2026). The copyright line is dated 2000. Game text: "If you occupy, Decipher gets the CCG license here." See [[Playtest cards#Skywalker Ranch]] and [[Decipher and the Star Wars CCG Lucasfilm license]].
